title: athyrium silvicola var. kinokuniense
intro: Athyrium silvicola var. kinokuniense, commonly known as Japanese lady fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Athyriaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Japanese lady fern include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
